title: The day has arrived; today I published my first video game :')
author: PandaRojasStudios
selftext:
After so much time and so much effort, the moment has arrived.  
Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4982990/Nova\_Survivors/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4982990/Nova_Survivors/)

comments.author: WWEtrump
comments.body: congrats on shipping your first game, that is a real milestone. i'm still waiting on steamworks approval so i'm jealous of the live page. did you do any marketing before launch, or was it mostly organic? and roughly how many wishlists did you have on day one?

replies.author: PandaRojasStudios
replies.body: Gracias amigo, mas tarde te paso las estadísticas

comments.author: Inside-Cantaloupe233
comments.body: Wrong sub, dood, you cant market your game to other devs ! You will come back here wondering why it flopped ? This is like marketing your restaurant to... other restaurant owners ! WE ARE YOUR COMPETITION.

replies.author: Inside-Cantaloupe233
replies.body: No me rompas el corazón, mi amor.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/PandaRojasStudios, this falls under Rule 4. Commercial posts are okay here, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).

replies.author: PandaRojasStudios
replies.body: Entiendo, gracias por avisar, voy a empezar a editar ahora
